Due to a permanent access restriction, no direct conduit exists between Facility Alpha and Facility Beta.
Furthermore, due to a scheduling mandate, exactly one of the following two links must be incorporated into the inspection sequence: the connection between Beta and Gamma, or the connection between Gamma and Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal-duration closed-loop itinerary that inspects each facility precisely once before returning to the point of origin.
